title: Resources of the advantage in quantum illumination: Discord and entanglement
summary: We investigate how the quantum advantage in quantum illumination is determined by an interplay between entanglement and discord of the probe state. In particular, we consider a setup in which the probe is a maximally mixed marginal (MMM) state and the environmental state is completely mixed where the quantum advantage equals the amount of discord consumed for illumination. Through a conditional extremal analysis, we determine the range of accessible advantages for given values of entanglement and discord.
